project.title: Huntingtin structure-function open lab notebook
project.description: Rachel Harding's open lab notebook at the Structural Genomics Consortium, University of Toronto, on the structure and function of huntingtin, the protein behind Huntington's disease. Imported from the write-ups she and her colleagues published on Zenodo; each entry credits its own authors and record. ProtoELN isn't connected with, or endorsed by, the authors or the SGC.
